## 🐛 Fixed

- **The image takes port 443 on Proxmox VE.** With `PARLEYPORT_DOMAIN` set, the relay listens on 443 as user 99:100. Docker allows that, but an LXC such as the one Proxmox runs the image in keeps ports below 1024 for root, so the relay stopped at `listen tcp :443: bind: permission denied`. The binary in the image now carries the capability to bind low ports. Only the image changes. A relay that runs as its own binary outside a container is not affected.
